title: The Ebutale
description: A vibrant new dimension, The Ebutale. Includes new structures, mobs, biomes and more!
body:
The Ebutale describes the story of the dimension of the Eburis, the new dimension added by this mod. This new dimension adds a variety of exciting new content, including: 

- New mobs with interesting mechanics, behaviour, custom animations and special drops.
- Diverse new biomes, housing these mobs and custom structures, providing interesting exploration!
- Custom wood types, with two types of wood: softwood, used by smaller conifer trees that bear fruit; and hardwood, used by towering deciduous trees. Both wood types have their respective tools and blocks!
- New stone generation, with different stones to fit the biomes, and their deep variations (similar to deepslate).
- A wide variety of new ores, with unique armour and tools!

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Tin/Copper (a low-grade material, used for basic armour and tools)

Flimsium (only used for tools, equivalent to iron)

Eburisian Silver (exclusively used to make armour, equivalent to iron)

Tritium (hardwood, equivalent to iron)

Mytrium (equivalent to diamond, less attack speed than Mytrium, but more damage)

Vervonite (equivalent to diamond, less attack speed than Mytrium, but more damage)

Zeptornite (a magical crystal with arcane powers!)

Pyronium (an extremely hot material, handle with care!)

Cryonium (an extremely cold material, also handle with care!)

</details>


## **So, how do you get to the Eburis?**

To enter the Eburis, you must first craft the Rift Opener using 2 gold ingots and a diamond.

![Rift Opener Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8acacf83ae2ac9fed5a7e9be8afdb52800ac835b.png)

Once you create this you must find the Anomaly Researcher, he can be found in open biomes such as the Plains, the Swamp etc.

![The Anomaly Researchers House](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7ef1878e82ba02b61d89f750cd2e60daad054ae_0.webp)

Trade with him until he offers the Powered Rift Opener. Once you have acquired it, you must find a Dimensional Sanctum, these are rare structures found in most biomes. You can find these by exploration, or the Altar Wayfinder (currently WIP) which will locate one within a radius of 500 blocks.

![The Dimensional Sanctum](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6c7527bbc0efa9ab114c8f3b4f52e2bfcb3e9e3_0.webp)

Once found, place the aformentioned Powered Rift Opener on the central Altar and power up the portal. Now, enter the portal to travel to the Eburis!
